comparison.objective: Cut a tube by progressively feeding and orbiting a tubing cutter without denting it; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Both require iterative rotary adjustment informed by physical progress. Record alternates feed-knob increments with full cutter revolutions; candidate adjusts a retained collar, locks it and runs separate impact cycles.
comparison.success_condition: Record measures circumferential groove depth, breakthrough and a 0.70 mm dent limit. Candidate measures non-bottoming stops, rebound/overload and setting drift, but several thresholds are unspecified.
comparison.reason: This is the closest process-level analogy, yet cutting through material via feed-and-orbit cycles is a meaningfully different tested ability from tuning and locking damping.
